hero.lead: Hand-sourced 1-of-1 designer pieces from Milan and Paris, paired with factory-sealed beauty and gold-plated hair accessories.

house.chip: The House Archive Edition, signature aesthetic
house.lead: One house signature: pre-styled HD lace wigs shipped in satin dust bags, croc-embossed espresso leather with twisted-braid clasps, factory-sealed velvet cosmetics and 1-of-1 vintage tailoring.

house.img2Alt: East-West braided clasp bag in espresso croc leather
house.ritualQuote: "Protect every HD lace hairline and roller-set wave overnight in 22-momme mulberry silk."
